claims.text: Southeast Asia propylene spot prices were assessed from January 2024 to December 2025, with no missing months in the series.
The spot price series for Southeast Asia propylene began at USD 875/tonne in January 2024 and ended at USD 918/tonne in December 2025.
The lowest monthly spot price for Southeast Asia propylene in this period was USD 834/tonne in January 2025.
The highest monthly spot price for Southeast Asia propylene in this period was USD 918/tonne in December 2025.
The mean spot price for Southeast Asia propylene from January 2024 to December 2025 was USD 871.5/tonne.
Spot prices rose from USD 875/tonne in January 2024 to a local peak of USD 911/tonne in March 2024, then declined to USD 838/tonne in December 2024.
Spot prices reached their lowest point in January 2025 at USD 834/tonne, then generally increased to USD 918/tonne by December 2025.
There is no spot price assessment for Southeast Asia propylene after December 2025; the series ends at that point.
The Monitor changed its Southeast Asia propylene assessment from a spot to a contract basis with effect from January 2026, following a change in how regional volumes are transacted.

citations.quote: Readers should note that the Monitor's propylene assessment for Southeast Asia moved from a spot to a contract basis with effect from January 2026, following a change in how regional volumes are transacted.

claims.text: The contract price series for Southeast Asia propylene runs from January 2026 to August 2026, with no missing months.
The contract price series began at USD 841/tonne in January 2026 and ended at USD 776/tonne in August 2026.
The highest contract price for Southeast Asia propylene in this period was USD 870/tonne in April 2026.
The lowest contract price for Southeast Asia propylene in this period was USD 776/tonne in August 2026.
The mean contract price for Southeast Asia propylene from January 2026 to August 2026 was USD 818.38/tonne.
The Monitor advises against comparing pre- and post-January 2026 propylene values directly, as the change in basis reflects a methodological shift rather than a market movement.

citations.quote: The resulting step in the published series reflects the change of basis and should not be read as a market movement. The Monitor advises against comparing pre- and post-January propylene values directly.

gaps.subject: Southeast Asia propylene spot price assessments after December 2025
gaps.detail: No spot price assessments are published for Southeast Asia propylene after December 2025; the series ends at that point.

gaps.subject: Southeast Asia propylene contract price assessments before January 2026
gaps.detail: No contract price assessments are published for Southeast Asia propylene before January 2026; the series begins at that point.

coverage_note: Spot price coverage is complete from January 2024 to December 2025, and contract price coverage is complete from January 2026 to August 2026. There is a methodological break between the two series, and values are not directly comparable across this change.
